meta.name: ultimate-browsing
meta.description: Escalation skill for blocked or hard-to-reach web access — load it when a normal browse/fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, Cloudflare, JS-only render, login-gated, or a platform a generic fetcher cannot read). Tiered router: TIER 1 insane-search (headless extraction + WAF bypass via curl_cffi TLS impersonation, yt-dlp, Jina Reader, public APIs, Playwright real-Chrome fallback); TIER 1.5 agent-reach (platform-native readers for Chinese and social platforms: Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, Bilibili, V2EX, WeChat, plus Twitter/Reddit/LinkedIn/GitHub); TIER 2 Chrome stealth (CloakBrowser stealth Chromium + agent-browser CDP for clicks, forms, screenshots, video, cookie login). Triggers: blocked site, bypass bot detection, cloudflare/WAF bypass, scrape, stealth browser, import cookies, fill form, screenshot, play youtube, xiaohongshu, douyin, weibo, bilibili, v2ex, wechat article, podcast transcript. NOT for simple searches (use web-search) or plain fetches (use webfetch).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常遇到网页打不开或需要抓取被屏蔽的内容
copy.tagline_en: Bypass web access blocks and scrape restricted pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often hit blocked pages or need to extract gated content

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 遇到被 WAF/Cloudflare 拦截、需要 JS 渲染或有登录墙的网页时,会先尝试无头抓取绕过,再改用小红书、抖音、微博等平台的专用接口,最后用隐身浏览器模拟点击、截图、注入 Cookie,产出页面文本、字幕或截图。
howto.when: 当页面被 WAF/Cloudflare 等拦截、需要 JS 渲染或有登录墙时触发;也用于小红书、抖音、微博等平台内容,以及截图、填表等交互。简单搜索或普通抓取不触发。

say.text: 这个链接被 Cloudflare 拦截了,帮我提取正文。
say.note: 会先跑无头抓取,自动尝试绕过。

say.text: 读取这条小红书/抖音链接的内容。
say.note: 会走平台原生接口读取。

say.text: 打开这个页面,点击按钮然后截图。
say.note: 会启动隐身浏览器模拟操作。

howto.what_en: With it, Claude handles blocked pages in three tiers: headless WAF/Cloudflare bypass, platform-native reads (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo), then stealth-browser clicks/screenshots/cookie login. Output: page text, subtitles, screenshots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a page is blocked by WAF/Cloudflare, needs JS rendering, or has a login wall; also for Xiaohongshu/Douyin/Weibo content and screenshot/form-fill interactions. Not for simple searches.

say_en.text: This link is blocked by Cloudflare — extract the article text for me.
say_en.note: It will try headless extraction and auto-bypass first.

say_en.text: Read the content of this Xiaohongshu/Douyin link.
Open this page, click the button, and take a screenshot.
